facts.statement: Pontotoc County hunters have a local, around-the-clock drop-off for chronic wasting disease testing as the regular deer gun season opens Saturday, Nov. 21. The state wildlife department lists the Pontotoc Ag Center at 430 C.J. Hardin Jr. Drive. Its online directory gives the site’s hours as 24 hours, and its printed season guide lists the same address.
facts.evidence: Matched the Pontotoc row in the live hours directory to site 12 in the season guide and checked the Nov. 21 opening in the dated season table.

facts.statement: U.S. 278 marks an important boundary within the county. Land north of the highway in Pontotoc County falls within the North Mississippi chronic wasting disease management zone. The state bans supplemental feeding in the zone, including the use of feeders, salt licks and mineral licks. It also restricts moving whole deer carcasses out of the zone.
facts.evidence: The September notice explicitly names the portion of Pontotoc County north of Highway 278 and lists the feeding and transport restrictions.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County hunters have a local, around-the-clock drop-off for chronic wasting disease testing as the regular deer gun season opens Saturday, Nov. 21. The state wildlife department lists the Pontotoc Ag Center at 430 C.J. Hardin Jr. Drive. Its online directory gives the site’s hours as 24 hours, and its printed season guide lists the same address.

U.S. 278 marks an important boundary within the county. Land north of the highway in Pontotoc County falls within the North Mississippi chronic wasting disease management zone. The state bans supplemental feeding in the zone, including the use of feeders, salt licks and mineral licks. It also restricts moving whole deer carcasses out of the zone.

The department encourages hunters to submit deer for testing. Its season guide also lists participating taxidermists as an option. Results are usually available within two weeks of collection and can be checked through the department’s chronic wasting disease website.
